observations.body: Cut to the heart, the hearers ask what to do; Peter calls for repentance and baptism, promises forgiveness and the Holy Spirit, and about three thousand receive the word.
observations.label: The hearers ask, respond, are baptized, and are added

observations.body: The passage presents Repenting, baptizing, receiving, and adding as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Repenting, baptizing, receiving, and adding

observations.body: The passage places Hearers, children, and those far off beside Repenting, baptizing, receiving, and adding.
observations.label: Hearers, children, and those far off

payload.posture: Read Acts 2:37–41 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states cut to the heart, the hearers ask what to do; Peter calls for repentance and baptism, promises forgiveness and the Holy Spirit, and about three thousand receive the word. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: The hearers ask, respond, are baptized, and are added
